items.title: Steering coupling may be under-tightened
items.summary: Insufficiently tightened steering coupling can wear the steering connection; 10,832 G 550, G 63 and G 65s

items.title: Inner door-release cable may break
items.summary: Cable can snap if the door is hard to open, e.g. after a crash (FMVSS 206)

items.title: ESP fault with DISTRONIC PLUS engaged
items.summary: An ESP malfunction while DISTRONIC PLUS is on may stop the engine reducing power; 8,043 trucks

items.title: eCall date/time software fault
items.summary: Emergency-call clock error can relay an inaccurate vehicle location

items.title: Communication-module software (eCall location)
items.summary: Communication module may fail to send the correct vehicle location in an emergency call

timeline.change: G 63 AMG and G 65 AMG revealed in April with the 2012 interior update; M157 5.5 biturbo V8 (544 PS, 760 Nm) and 7G-TRONIC replace the G 55's supercharged V8 and five-speed
US launch (MY2013, on sale August 2012) at $134,300; EPA 12/14 mpg
G 63 AMG 6×6 goes into limited production at Magna Steyr in Graz
Last pre-facelift model year; the cheapest way into a W463 G 63 today
Renamed Mercedes-AMG G 63; 571 PS (563 hp), new shock absorbers, revised ASR/ABS and instruments; Edition 463 and colour packages
Recalls 17V178 (door cable) and 17V713 (ESP with DISTRONIC PLUS) cover 2016 trucks; 17V250 (steering coupling) covers 2013–2016
Last model year of this body; EPA highway rating rises to 15 mpg
Replaced by the second-generation G 63 with the M177 4.0 V8 and independent front suspension

identify.intro: Dressing up G 550s as AMGs is common, and so are aftermarket 'G 63 conversions'. The VIN and the engine tell you what left Graz.

items.head: VIN characters 4–8
items.body: US G 63s sold on Bring a Trailer read WDCYC7DF… (2013–2016 examples) and WDCYC7DH… (2018). A 2011 G 55 reads WDCYC7BF… and a same-era G 550 WDCYC3HF….

items.head: Engine
items.body: A G 63 has the M157 5.5-litre biturbo V8: two turbochargers and AMG engine covers, and no supercharger on top. A G 550 has either the naturally aspirated M273 (to 2015) or the 4.0-litre M176.

items.head: Brakes and wheels
items.body: Factory G 63s have six-piston front calipers from the ML 63 on 14.8-inch discs, and 20-inch AMG wheels.

items.head: Power by year
items.body: 2013–2015 trucks are 544 PS; 2016–2018 trucks, badged Mercedes-AMG G 63, are 571 PS (563 hp).

capability.note: MotorTrend; Mercedes quotes 600 mm for the production G
MotorTrend test truck; KBB says 'well over 5,600 pounds'

values.intro: Values are flat to soft. The truck's age and the M157's reputation keep prices well below a second-generation G 63, and mileage and service history set the price more than the year does.
values.note: Based on 57 Bring a Trailer sales of stock W463 G 63s from January 2025 to October 2026 (median $65,500; 2013–15 median $61,000, 2016–18 median $76,750). 6×6, Brabus, armoured and converted trucks are excluded.
